typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	executionInstanceGUID as string ()
}
 derive(W_Update_DT = currentTimestamp(),
		ETL_PROC_WID = $executionInstanceGUID) ~> ETLIDs1	source(output(
		Tax_ID_Number as string,
		Datasource_NUM_ID as string,
		Additional_Address_Info as string,
		Delivery_Adddress as string,
		City_State as string,
		City as string,
		State as string,
		Zip as string,
		CFM_INFO_ATTN as string,
		Integration_ID as string,
		W_Insert_DT as timestamp,
		W_Update_DT as timestamp,
		ETL_PROC_WID as string,
		CFK_CIF_NBR as string,
		Customer_Business_Key as string,
		Customer_Business_Key_Type as string,
		Application_CD as string,
		Association_Number as string,
		Account_CD as string,
		Account_Type as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	format: 'table',
	staged:false) ~> SDimLoanCustomer
SDimLoanCustomer split(Customer_Business_Key == '-1', disjoint: true) ~> ConditionalSplit@(Case1,ConditionalSplitDefaultOutput)
ETLIDs1 sink(input(
		{} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		{} = Param_6)) ~> OLEDBCommand
ConditionalSplit@ConditionalSplitDefaultOutput derive(State = iif(isNull(State), substring(toString(City_State), toInteger(locate(', ', City_State, 1) + 2), toInteger(2)), State),
		City = iif(isNull(City), substring(toString(City_State), toInteger(1), toInteger(locate(', ', City_State, 1) - 1)), City)) ~> SeparateCityState
SeparateCityState sort(asc(Customer_Business_Key, false),asc(Customer_Business_Key_Type, false)) ~> Sort
Sort lookup(TO_BE_FIXED_LOOKUP_KEYS == TO_BE_FIXED_LOOKUP_KEYS,
	multiple: false,
	pickup: 'first',
	broadcast: 'none')~> InsertorUpdateDimCustomerAdressCONNECTEDLOOKUP
InsertorUpdateDimCustomerAdressCONNECTEDLOOKUP derive(SrcDimensionKeys = sha2(256,'')) ~> InsertorUpdateDimCustomerAdressREFORMATCOMPONENT
InsertorUpdateDimCustomerAdressREFORMATCOMPONENT select(mapColumn(
		SrcDimensionKeys = SrcDimensionKeys
	),
	 skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	 skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> InsertorUpdateDimCustomerAdressSELECTCOMPONENT
InsertorUpdateDimCustomerAdressSELECTCOMPONENT derive(W_Insert_DT = currentTimestamp(),
		W_Update_DT = currentTimestamp(),
		ETL_PROC_WID = $executionInstanceGUID) ~> ETLIDs
ETLIDs sink(input(
		Zip as string,
		W_Update_DT as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		Integration_ID as string,
		City as string,
		ETL_PROC_WID as string,
		CFM_INFO_ATTN as string,
		CFK_CIF_NBR as string,
		Datasource_NUM_ID as string,
		W_Insert_DT as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		Additional_Address_Info as string,
		Customer_Business_Key as string,
		City_State as string,
		State as string,
		Delivery_Adddress as string,
		Tax_ID_Number as string,
		Customer_Business_Key_Type as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		Zip,
		W_Update_DT,
		Integration_ID,
		City,
		ETL_PROC_WID,
		CFM_INFO_ATTN,
		CFK_CIF_NBR,
		Datasource_NUM_ID,
		W_Insert_DT,
		Additional_Address_Info,
		Customer_Business_Key,
		City_State,
		State,
		Delivery_Adddress,
		Tax_ID_Number,
		Customer_Business_Key_Type)) ~> InsertDestination
